description.text:
Your Responsibilities
• Software based EV thermal management control logic development(integration of battery/HVAC/powertrain).
• Software development, test and validation according to national regulations.
• 1D EV thermal management simulation.
You Have
• Proven ability to develop control logic with Matlab/Simulink.
• Familiar with star ccm+/GT-GUITE
• Cooperate with thermal engineer to meet the performance target.
• M.S. or higher degree in a technical field.
Great to Have
• Excellent communication and troubleshooting skills.
• Familiarity with EV thermal management architecture.
• Familiarity with Finite Element modeling and CFD analysis.
• Familiarity with CAN bus communication knowledge.
